name: mission-readiness-mcp
description: MCP server exposing Mission Readiness Officer tools to IBM Bob

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='build/index.js'; let c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!c.startsWith('#!/usr/bin/env node')){fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c);} require('fs').chmodSync(p,0o755);"
